name: planner
description: Work out the data shape, seams, call sites and phase order before code. Use when a change crosses a boundary or the design is not settled.

name: explorer
description: Read-only investigation: how a subsystem works, why it is built this way, where a change would land. Use before deciding anything.

name: worker
description: Implement one scoped change and prove it with the evidence the kickoff names. Use for code, tests and docs that one checkout can carry.

name: reviewer
description: Try to break a diff: correctness, regressions, blast radius, missing tests. Use on every non-trivial change, on a different model family from the author.

name: verifier
description: Independently prove the behavior on the real artifact, not the author's summary. Use before a change ships or a pull request merges.
